# Vendored: CLI11

Snapshot of **CLI11**, a command-line parser for C++11.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11>
- Version: **v2.6.2** (2026-02-26)
- License: BSD-3-Clause (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE))

Vendored as the **single-include amalgamated header** `CLI11.hpp`, which is a
GitHub release asset (generated), not a file in the repo source tree.

## Local patches

None — pristine upstream.

## Updating

Download the `CLI11.hpp` release asset and `LICENSE` for the new tag:

```
curl -L .../releases/download/vX.Y.Z/CLI11.hpp -o CLI11.hpp
curl -L .../raw/vX.Y.Z/LICENSE                 -o LICENSE
```
